in_hebrew.name: אלוין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'alah' meaning 'to go up' or 'to rise', this name signifies someone who is exalted or lifted up. It is often used to describe a divine being or a person who is considered to be of great importance.

in_greek.name: Αλωινός
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root 'aloos' meaning 'not down' or 'not low', this name signifies someone who is exalted or lifted up. It is often used to describe a person of noble character or someone who is considered to be of high status.

in_latin.name: Aloinus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root 'altus' meaning 'high' or 'lofty', this name signifies someone who is exalted or lifted up. It is often used to describe a person of noble character or someone who is considered to be of high status.
